description: This file implements internal functions and classes for handling first-class dimension indexing and setting in PyTorch tensors, including dimension binding, index extraction, and advanced indexing logic within the functorch extension.

classes.name: IndexingInfo
classes.description: Data class encapsulating information about tensor indexing operations, including whether original methods can be called, if advanced indexing is used, tensor references, flattened inputs, result levels, and device info.

methods.name: _safe_index
methods.description: Helper function to find the index of an item in a list, with special handling for DimEntry objects.

methods.name: has_dims
methods.description: Checks if an object has first-class dimensions, either as a Dim or a functorch Tensor.

methods.name: _bind_dims_to_size
methods.description: Binds unbound dimensions to a specified size and calculates proper strides for dimension packs.

methods.name: slice_to_tuple
methods.description: Converts a list of inputs into a tuple, used for indexing.

methods.name: extractIndices
methods.description: Extracts indices from various input types, handling sequences, tensors, slices, and other iterables.

methods.name: getitem
methods.description: Performs tensor getitem operation with support for first-class dimensions and advanced indexing.

methods.name: setitem
methods.description: Sets tensor values using first-class dimensions, with support for advanced indexing and dimension matching.

methods.name: invoke_getitem
methods.description: Helper to perform the actual getitem operation, handling advanced indexing.

methods.name: getsetitem
methods.description: Main function to handle get/set item operations with first-class dimension support, including expansion of ... and dimension binding.

methods.name: getsetitem_flat
methods.description: Processes flattened index inputs, matches tensor levels, and prepares tensors for get/set operations.
